register.labelZh: REST 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 你可以用 rest on 說明球隊、計劃、活動或項目能否成功取決於甚麼。；rest with 可以清楚表示由誰作出決定或承擔責任。；這些表達常用於談論希望、結果、重要選擇和責任。；rest on 表示結果取決於甚麼;rest with 則表示由誰決定或負責。
register.summaryEn: You can use rest on to explain what controls the success of a team, plan, event or project. Rest with clearly shows who must make a decision or take responsibility. These expressions are often used when discussing hopes, results, important choices and responsibility. Rest on shows what an outcome depends on. Rest with shows who must decide or act.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 當希望、結果或計劃取決於某人或某事物時,使用 rest on somebody/something 或 rest uponsomebody/something。；當責任或最終決定權在某人手上時,使用 rest with somebody。；核心表達是 rest with somebody。其後可以加上 to + 動詞,說明該人需要決定或負責甚麼。The decision rests with the coach.(決定權在教練手上。)It rests with the coach to choose the final player.(最後一名球員由教練負責選出。)
fixedVariable.variableEn: Use rest on somebody/something or rest upon somebody/something when a hope, result or plan depends on that person or thing. Use rest with somebody when that person has the responsibility or final choice. The core expression is rest with somebody. You may add to + verb to explain what that person must decide or do.
